reactableEdit: Interactive and Editable Data Tables for R

Source: R/reactable.R
reactableEdit-package.Rd

Interactive data tables for R, based on the 'React Table' JavaScript library. Provides an HTML widget that can be used in 'R Markdown' or 'Quarto' documents, 'Shiny' applications, or viewed from an R console. An independent fork of the 'reactable' package by Greg Lin, adding native 'Shiny' cell inputs with server validation, configurable disabled states, row addition and removal, and rich tooltips. Not an official release of the original 'reactable' project.

Details

reactableEdit is an independent fork of reactable, originally developed by Greg Lin. It adds native Shiny cell editing with server validation, configurable input states, row actions, and rich tooltips. It is not an official release of the original project.

See the fork repository for development and issue reports. The upstream documentation describes the shared API, but not the extensions in this fork.

Load the package with library(reactableEdit). Function names such as reactable() and reactableOutput(), the Reactable JavaScript API, widget classes, and reactable.* options retain their original names for compatibility. The two packages can be installed alongside each other, but should not be loaded together or have their widgets mixed in the same HTML document.
